Course · French for English speakers

Learn French from first words to C1.

A complete course in the French of France: 76 modules in eight tiers, with the grammar explained directly, from être and the articles to the subjunctive, the passive and the literary tenses. Every answer gets feedback that says why, and every French word can be tapped for its meaning, forms and audio.

Start learning free

The whole course is free, with the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test. Specializations, DELF, DALF and TCF practice papers, stories, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

The course, tier by tier

  1. 1 · Sounds and first wordsPronunciation and spelling, greetings, nouns and articles, être and numbers.
  2. 2 · Everyday basics-er verbs, avoir, adjectives, negation, questions, family and time.
  3. 3 · Daily lifeIrregular, modal and pronominal verbs, the partitive, food, the city and shopping.
  4. 4 · The pastThe passé composé and the imperfect, object pronouns, travel, health and the home.
  5. 5 · Building fluencyY and en, the future, the conditional, the imperative and a first look at the subjunctive.
  6. 6 · IntermediateMore subjunctive, the pluperfect, the past conditional, reported speech and the gerund.
  7. 7 · Upper intermediateThe passive, conjunctions with the subjunctive, connectors, nominal style and society.
  8. 8 · AdvancedLiterary tenses, emphasis, style, idioms, spoken French and the French spoken around the world.

76 modules from A1 to C1. The placement test suggests where to start if you already know some French.

How it teaches

Grammar explained, practice that says why

  • 1

    Grammar taught directly

    Modules explain the grammar before you practise it: when the passé composé takes être, how it differs from the imperfect, what triggers the subjunctive, where y and en go. The grammar reference keeps every explanation in one place.

  • 2

    Feedback with a reason

    A wrong answer gets an explanation of what was wrong and a link to the rule, not just a red mark. A translation worded differently from the expected answer can still be accepted.

  • 3

    Every word inspectable

    Tap any French word in an exercise, text or explanation for its meaning, its full table of forms and its audio, and add it to word practice.

  • 4

    Listening, writing and speaking

    Exercises include dictation, listening, translation both ways, gap fills, reading texts and free writing, and speaking exercises with pronunciation feedback.

  • 5

    The French people actually use

    The French of France, with modules on spoken French, register and style, and the French spoken in other countries. Twelve sets of common traps cover false friends and the mistakes English speakers tend to make.

  • 6

    No gamification

    No streaks, points or mascots. Progress is the share of the course you have finished, and the vocabulary page shows how many words you know.

Exam preparation

Practice papers for DELF, DALF and TCF

The course has two timed practice papers for each of these exams, in their task formats and with original content. Listening and reading are shorter than in the real exams, the writing is full length, and none of them has a speaking test.

  • DELF A1, A2, B1 and B2: listening, reading and writing.
  • DALF C1: listening, reading and the full 2 hours 30 minutes of writing.
  • DALF C2: the reading-and-writing test, at full length.
  • TCF tout public: listening, language structures, reading and writing.
  • TCF IRN, the TCF for residence cards and French nationality: listening, reading and writing.
  • What the exams ask and where the papers differ from them: DELF, DALF and TCF practice.

Questions

Common questions

Is the French course really free?
Yes. All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice, the placement test, the common traps and 5 Ask AI questions a day are free. Premium adds the specializations, exam papers, stories, conversations and other extras.
Which French does the course teach?
The French of France. The advanced tier has modules on spoken French and on the French spoken in other countries.
I already know some French. Do I have to start at the beginning?
No. The placement test suggests where to start.
Does it prepare me for the DELF or the TCF?
The course goes from A1 to C1, and Premium has practice papers for DELF A1 to B2, DALF C1 and C2, the TCF and the TCF IRN. The papers do not cover speaking and do not convert your result into a grade or a level; the exam page explains what they cover.
I speak Finnish, German, Russian or Ukrainian. Is there a course for me?
Yes. French is also taught with explanations in Finnish, Ranska suomenkielisille, in German, Französisch für Deutschsprachige, and in Russian and Ukrainian, French for Russian speakers and French for Ukrainian speakers, with the grammar compared with your language.
